name: Tree Search for LM Agents (best-first search agent)

system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: we run the multimodal agent from Koh et al. (2024) with the same prompt
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; prompt mechanism not described beyond reuse of prior prompts.

env_context_strategy.note: Observation is the current webpage (SoM screenshot / a11y tree); no repository context concept; no config surface available.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no history-processing place in evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The input to the agent is a screenshot of the SoM-annotated webpage, and a text description of the elements on the page with their assigned IDs.
observation_format.note: SoM default for GPT-4o on VWA; accessibility tree used for caption-augmented and text-only agents; value function uses screenshots.

tool_call_format.note: Actions are text commands with bracketed arguments (WebArena action space); closest value cli_flags.

tool_count.evidence_quote:
Table 1: Possible actions A in the (Vi-
sual)WebArena environments.
tool_count.note: 12 action types listed in Tab. 1; these are environment actions rather than function schemas.

edit_primitive.note: Web domain; no file editing discussed; no code available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Our approach is a form of best-first tree search that operates within the actual environment space
loop_primitives.note: Base agent is CoT/ReAct-style prompting; search is the default contribution. Trajectory reranking (multi_attempt) was only an ablation baseline.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: At each step of execution, we generate 20 outputs from the model by prompting it with CoT reasoning

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: We use a language model agent to propose candidate branches of the search tree.
multi_agent_topology.note: Separate value-function model scores states; still a single agent.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
initializing the frontierF←{} (implemented
as a max priority queue) which holds the set of states that we plan to evaluate
short_term_state.note: Frontier, best state, best score, search counter maintained.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
We implement the value function by prompting a multimodal language model
with the task instructionI, screenshots of the agent's trajectory

retry_policy.note: Task-level retries not described; search backtracking is within-attempt.

rollback.evidence_quote: During backtracking, we reset the environment and apply the same sequence after resetting the environment.
rollback.note: Environment reset plus action replay; closest value snapshot.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
Our search parameters are set tod = 5,b = 5,c = 20, and we stop execution after
a maximum of 5 actions.
termination_condition.note: stop [answer] action (Tab. 1) is model-declared end; search terminates on v>=theta or budget c.

cost_controls.note: Search budget c limits node expansions, not tokens/cost.

execution_isolation.note: Runs on self-hosted (V)WA simulators; execution boundary not described.

permission_model.note: Destructive-action classifier proposed as future work only.

replayability.note: Action-sequence replay used internally for backtracking only.

eval_hooks.note: Evaluated on VWA/WA but code repo not in evidence.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
we propose
an inference-time search algorithm for LM agents to explicitly perform exploration and
multi-step planning in interactive web environments.
